items.title: Nvidia leadership crisis drives roughly 7% premarket slide and global chip pressure
items.summary: Nvidia dropped roughly 7% in early Thursday trading after Reuters confirmed its board met to consider CEO Jensen Huang's future. No removal has been announced. Founder-dependence, China export scrutiny and AI-infrastructure financing amplify the spillover risk; a formal board decision would be the next decisive signal.

observations.label: NVDA early Thursday trading
observations.value: Approximately -7% premarket/Frankfurt; intraday indication, not an official close

observations.label: Asian equity spillover
observations.value: Taiwan benchmark -2.6%; MSCI Asia-Pacific ex-Japan -1.2% in Reuters early-November-12 report

observations.label: Leadership status
observations.value: Reuters confirmed board met November 11; no dismissal announcement verified

observations.label: Fundamental assessment / risk
observations.value: Nvidia retains a critical AI-compute franchise, but concentrated leadership and export controls threaten execution and customers' infrastructure plans

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Official board/company statement, SEC disclosure, export rules, US open and chip-sector breadth

items.key_finding: An unconfirmed leadership outcome is producing a confirmed cross-market risk signal, not a fundamental-demand collapse.

sources.title: Reuters, Nvidia board weighs CEO Huang's future, November 12
Reuters, global stocks and rates, November 12

items.title: Verified VLCC strike injures four in Gulf as Hormuz attacks persist despite softer crude
items.summary: India's shipping minister confirmed a projectile hit VLCC Fujairah Energy on November 10, injuring four crew members. Maritime reporting identifies other November 10–11 tanker incidents, with some details still preliminary. This is physical shipping disruption rather than a market rumor, even as oil prices soften on hopes of diplomacy.

observations.label: Confirmed vessel incident
observations.value: MT Fujairah Energy struck November 10 en route Al Ruwais to Dubai; four of 22 crew injured; Indian shipping minister reported November 11

observations.label: Other vessel reports
observations.value: Seatrade Maritime reports Sea 1 hit November 10 and possible NCC Fajr incident November 11; details vary in certainty

observations.label: Thursday crude price observation
observations.value: WSJ reported front-month Brent $91.79 (-1%) and WTI $85.69 (-1%) early November 12; not settlement

observations.label: Safety authority context
observations.value: IMO November 11 statement reports more than 130 attacks on commercial shipping in and around Hormuz during the conflict

observations.label: Next indicators / invalidation
observations.value: UKMTO notices, verified tanker transits and exports, additional vessel damage, US-Iran negotiations, EIA petroleum data noon ET

items.key_finding: Physical-flow risk remains elevated even though oil prices are repricing diplomatic optimism.

items.title: US 10-year yield tests 5% as December Fed tightening expectations jump
items.summary: The US 10-year Treasury yield touched about 5% Thursday as investors absorbed hotter October inflation. Reuters reported markets pricing about a 90% probability of a quarter-point December hike, while the dollar reached a 19-month high. Higher financing costs particularly pressure leveraged AI infrastructure and other long-duration assets; declining yields would weaken this risk signal.

observations.label: US Treasury 10-year yield
observations.value: Briefly about 5.0% early November 12; MarketWatch cited 5.004%

observations.label: December Fed probabilities
observations.value: Reuters quoted CME FedWatch around 90% for +25 basis points, about 9.2% for +50 basis points

observations.label: Dollar trend
observations.value: Reuters described dollar at 19-month high early November 12

observations.label: Fundamental significance
observations.value: Higher funding costs compound capex and debt burdens of high-growth datacenter and cloud-buildout businesses

observations.label: Next indicators
observations.value: Treasury yields into US cash open, Fed commentary, inflation revisions, US dollar, credit spreads

items.key_finding: The rate shock raises the cost of financing AI and grid infrastructure independent of chip-demand strength.

sources.title: Wall Street Journal October CPI and Treasury yields, November 11

items.title: Anthropic IPO bankers consider higher pricing amid reported strong demand
items.summary: Anthropic's November 10 SEC filing sets a proposed $70–$78 IPO range. Financial Times reports bankers are considering a higher price after strong demand, potentially lifting the fully diluted valuation above $1.5 trillion. No revised range has been filed or pricing completed; infrastructure spending and future cash generation remain major risks.

observations.label: SEC preliminary filing, November 10
observations.value: 825 million Class A shares offered at proposed $70–$78; Nasdaq ticker ANT proposed, not yet trading

observations.label: Reported banker consideration, November 11
observations.value: FT reports potential $1.5 trillion or higher fully diluted valuation; not filed or finalized

observations.label: Conditional strategic financing
observations.value: SEC filing describes $26 billion concurrent private placement by Google, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC

observations.label: Fundamental risk and next verification
observations.value: Approximately $900.9 billion committed future compute/infrastructure spend in SEC filing; watch amended prospectus, final price, financing and cash generation

items.key_finding: Reported strong IPO demand signals AI capital-market appetite, but higher pricing remains unconfirmed.

items.title: Semiconductor rally finishes with every index component advancing
items.summary: Chip participation broadened beyond the largest AI names. Reuters' closing report replaces the earlier intraday breadth narrative; repeat participation and earnings delivery are the next tests.

observations.label: November 11 regular-session close, 4:00 PM EST

observations.label: Timestamp qualification

items.key_finding: Broad chip participation strengthens the recovery signal; one session does not establish durability.
